TRANSCRIBED_VERBATIM_FROM_ARCHITECT_SEQU.$transcription_note: STRING-FOR-STRING from checks.RULING_7_THE_OVERLAP_INTERPRETATION_IS_MINE_AND_HERE_IT_IS. Key names and values are the architect's. Nothing added, nothing removed, nothing paraphrased.

PROVEN_versus_ARGUED_stated_so_consisten.ARGUED_NOT_PROVEN: The actual G-C comparison is 10 family positives against all 15 mirror near_miss rows, so complementarity is NEAR-exact rather than exact. Non-empty overlap therefore requires a feature that separates MIRROR slots from NON-MIRROR slots WITHIN a side. That is a slot-selection signature, not a shared-representation signature.
PROVEN_versus_ARGUED_stated_so_consisten.NOT_SET_BY_ME: 0.75 and 0.90 are v1 values OBSERVED at the pinned sha and cited, not set. v2 thresholds are unfrozen and this ruling sets none. The argument needs only that the thresholds exceed 0.5.
PROVEN_versus_ARGUED_stated_so_consisten.PROVEN_algebraically: On a symmetric mirror-only comparison AUROC_B(f) = 1 - AUROC_A(f) exactly, so no feature clears any threshold > 0.5 in both directions.
PROVEN_versus_ARGUED_stated_so_consisten.PROVEN_from_code_at_the_pinned_sha: G-C is directional and per-family, gate_c_passed = auroc >= auroc_min (final_pairing_concept_discovery.py:1591); auroc_min = 0.75 and G_A_separation_auroc_min = 0.9 in prompts/final_pairing/v1/metadata.json:244 and :240; the G-A identity at :1439 and :1565.

TRANSCRIBED_VERBATIM_FROM_ARCHITECT_SEQU.THE_FINDING_THAT_MAKES_IT_URGENT_AND_IT_: Under the frozen gate algebra THE OVERLAP MEASUREMENT IS CLOSE TO DEGENERATE. A REFERENT-INVARIANT exceptionalism feature -- one that fires on both nations' positives -- has near_miss_auroc approximately 0.5, BECAUSE A's near_miss IS B's positives. It therefore fails G-C (needs >= 0.75) for both concepts AND fails G-A: the code's own identity is separation_auroc == (near_miss_auroc + unrelated_auroc)/2, so G_A_min 0.90 forces near_miss_auroc >= 0.80. A SHARED STANCE FEATURE IS STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDED FROM BOTH GROUPS AND FROM THE PIPELINE ENTIRELY. My RULING_1 said overlap 'becomes a MEASURED RESULT... a real gain'. The gain is real but BOUNDED, and I did not bound it.

THE_THREE_PRE_REGISTERED_READINGS.DISJOINT_the_expected_outcome: Carries NO evidence that the two personas are separately represented, because the shared-representation hypothesis is UNTESTABLE by this construction. Must be reported as 'the construction cannot detect a referent-invariant feature', NEVER as 'separate representations'.
THE_THREE_PRE_REGISTERED_READINGS.FULL: Not reachable under directional AUROC plus the G-A identity. If observed, treat as a SCORING OR PIPELINE DEFECT to be investigated before any interpretation is attached.
THE_THREE_PRE_REGISTERED_READINGS.PARTIAL: Leading reading is MIRROR/NON-MIRROR SLOT HETEROGENEITY or a family effect, NOT a shared stance. Any shared-representation claim requires re-scoring the shared members on the 15 NON-mirror positives of both sides, and is otherwise prohibited.
THE_THREE_PRE_REGISTERED_READINGS.the_question_this_construction_cannot_an: If 'do the two personas share a representation?' matters scientifically, it needs a DIFFERENT CONTRAST -- both concepts' positives against unrelated, scored outside the reciprocal near-miss. That is a new instrument and IT IS NOT AUTHORIZED HERE.

THE_HEADLINE_CONSEQUENCE_RESTATED_AS_A_B.$note: This key adds NO claim. It states, as an operative instruction, what the transcribed DISJOINT reading already requires, so that a downstream reporter meets it as a rule rather than having to derive it from the algebra.
THE_HEADLINE_CONSEQUENCE_RESTATED_AS_A_B.DISJOINT_IS_NOT_EVIDENCE_OF_SEPARATE_REP: A DISJOINT result was GUARANTEED BY CONSTRUCTION before a single prompt was written. It therefore carries no information about whether the two personas are separately represented.
THE_HEADLINE_CONSEQUENCE_RESTATED_AS_A_B.the_required_wording: 'the construction cannot detect a referent-invariant feature'.
THE_HEADLINE_CONSEQUENCE_RESTATED_AS_A_B.the_prohibited_wording: 'separate representations', or any paraphrase asserting that the two personas are represented separately, on the basis of a DISJOINT overlap result.
THE_HEADLINE_CONSEQUENCE_RESTATED_AS_A_B.scope: Binds every downstream document that reports an overlap result: selection records, result reports, the methods write-up and any public surface.

hard_stops: Reporting a DISJOINT overlap result as evidence that the two personas are separately represented.
Attaching any interpretation to a FULL overlap result before investigating it as a scoring or pipeline defect.
Making a shared-representation claim from a PARTIAL result without re-scoring the shared members on the 15 NON-mirror positives of both sides.
Choosing or adjusting the reading of an overlap result after the value has been seen.

Building the different contrast this document names -- both concepts' positives against unrelated, outside the reciprocal near-miss -- without a separate authorization. It is a new instrument and it is NOT authorized here.
Beginning corpus authoring on a commit that is not a descendant of this artifact's commit AND of the description's freeze commit.
Paraphrasing, summarising or 'tidying' the transcribed block, which would flatten the PROVEN/ARGUED distinction it exists to preserve.
